dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250918-SLE-02](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250918-SLE-02) A flood occurred on Sep 18 2025 in Sierra Leone. It affected an estimated 37351 people and 211 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
